You have 4+ years of relevant experience, ideally at a fast-paced start-up or scale-up, and you've owned projects independently end to end.

You can point to real examples of scoping, building, and owning workflow automations end-to-end (Jira, HubSpot, Pipedream, Tines, Scriptrunner or similar), not just supporting them, and of leading cross-functional teams to deliver solutions, including managing stakeholders outside your own team.

Hands-on SQL experience is required, along with knowledge of Python or another scripting language. You've applied AI tools like Claude or Cursor to go from idea to working code or automation, this is a requirement and we do it on a daily basis.

We care more about the trajectory you're on, though experience in financial services, fintech, or B2B is particularly interesting to us.
Location and working policy
📍 Dublin - hybrid (3 days per week in the office)
The good stuff
25 days off, plus public holidays. Private healthcare, life insurance, and a pension. Equity - because you should own a piece of what you're building. Generous parental leave for primary and secondary caregivers. 60 days a year to work abroad from wherever you want.

As a Product Operations Manager for strategic programs, you will help lead our most important cross-functional product programs, including company-critical launches and large-scale customer rollouts, while owning the operating cadence for roadmap, planning and launch enablement. Lead the end-to-end execution of the company’s highest-priority product programs, from initial alignment through launch, rollout, and post-launch follow-through.
Build integrated program plans that clarify scope, milestones, owners, dependencies, decision points, success measures, and escalation paths.
Own the annual, half-year, and quarterly product planning cadence in partnership with Product, Design, and Engineering leadership.
Maintain a coherent, current view of the product roadmap across teams, including company priorities, major commitments, capacity constraints, sequencing, and cross-team dependencies.
Create effective forums for strategy reviews, roadmap decisions, launch reviews, executive updates, and retrospectives.
Close the loop between execution and improvement – capture what launches and planning cycles teach us, and turn it into better defaults for the next one.

4-8+ years of experience in product operations, technical program management, product management, business operations, or a related role within a technology company.
Demonstrated success leading complex, high-stakes, cross-functional product launches or multi-quarter programs from strategy through rollout and adoption.
Experience designing or running roadmap, prioritization, and planning cadences across multiple product and engineering teams.
A track record of building repeatable systems and ways of working – not just executing within existing ones.
Strong written and verbal communication, including experience delivering concise, decision-ready updates to executives and senior stakeholders.
Experience in enterprise B2B SaaS, complex customer implementations, migrations, or phased product rollouts is preferred.

We are seeking a dedicated and enthusiastic candidate to provide exceptional Customer Service management to the Airbnb community as a Regional Operations Manager. The ideal candidate is hospitable, analytical, and committed to delivering the highest standards of service through coaching and up-leveling their team. This is a full time position based in Canada - Remote Eligible.

The Regional Operations Manager supports one or more internal CS services. The Regional Operations Manager is an operational leadership role that requires substantial experience in customer service and team management. Regional Operations Managers oversee teams of approximately 4-8 people managers who each manage teams of 8-15 support agents.

ROMs should have the ability to guide and uplevel their team members, demonstrating top-level coaching skills and operations management knowledge. Strong organizational skills and the ability to balance real-time and planned work are also required.

They should also be adaptable and responsive in our fast paced environment, sometimes under pressure, while remaining flexible, proactive, resourceful, efficient and demonstrating a high level of professionalism and confidentiality.

Oversee a strong operational environment for your teams and ensure high quality support for the community from your team
Manage the team execution of complex, sensitive, and/or urgent issues that might pose a significant risk to our brand or community, including acting as the highest escalation point for case consults and high level escalations from other stakeholders
Meet with your direct reports regularly to review their work and provide high quality, behavior-based coaching; must be able to create a performance development strategy/plan for your service(s).
Provide best practices guidelines to your team on how to handle cases and situations, and ensure that ways of working are documented and followed.
Ensure that the team is consistently staffed appropriately and that staff complete onboarding and ongoing trainings.
For cases that involve internal stakeholders, guide your team to take proper action to case closure and in rare cases, support with in-the-weeds case handling.
Collaborate with Capacity Planning & WFP on setting minimum headcount, ensuring adequate coverage, contingency planning impacts of changes, and advocating for staffing needs vs. volume/work
Drive performance at the team manager, regional, and service level
Ensure individual team members are held accountable to performance goals in a fair and equitable manner by setting clear expectations, following-up individually, and coaching team members positively to develop and improve their skills in a tailored way
Manage both team manager and regional performance, including identifying trends in performance, providing corrective actions and positive overall feedback, and writing year end reviews and improvement plans
Ability to set and articulate the vision and focus for the quarter; deliver that vision and focus through all hands-type meetings
Share input and recommendations about service target setting.
Provide oversight on the overall service performance and contribute to reporting on trends and providing a holistic picture of the service to the Delivery Director
Build and nurture an engaged and diverse team
Own and manage end-to-end people strategy and operations within your team to foster a high performing and sustainable team environment. This includes hiring, driving onboarding, talent development, and people engagement/wellness/morale
Enable team and individual professional success through supporting and challenging your team to meet and exceed expectations with clear goals/expectations, feedback, one-on-ones, and coaching
Support team in professional development within team by finding and creating development opportunities and leveraging company-wide resources to regularly drive development within your team.
Keep up with day-to-day management duties such as time off approvals, team and one-on-one meetings, and managing Talent-related issues
Maintain a culture of openness, transparency and accountability allowing our teams to deliver their best work while being themselves
Demonstrate strong leadership on important issues including Diversity & Belonging, Allyship, Ethics, Compliance and maintaining high standards of service to the company
Support strategic initiatives within Delivery and your service as needed
Lead the team toward the successful execution of company or other strategic changes or goals within your service by cascading updates and changes, communicating new requirements, and providing feedback
Support, as needed, internal Delivery performance & operations improvement projects, in collaboration with the Delivery Excellence team and cross-functional partners
Think critically and constantly evaluate our procedures. Collect feedback from the team to identify opportunities to improve performance and better optimize processes for the team, service, and global community

8+ years of progressive experience in a customer service or an operations role, with 5 years in a role directly managing staff & the employee lifecycle, ideally managing other managers
Demonstrable experience in driving improved performance of teams as a manager
Experience in the deployment of resources to manage real-time crisis situations, including managing high severity/sensitivity cases and decision-making authority for losses
Experience in data analysis and reporting to identify performance trends, as well as developing and implementing performance management standards
Experience translating big picture goals and strategy into implementable and concrete actions for your teams, including setting operational or functional targets or performance goals
Ability to work weekend days, holidays, and on-call required

Exceptional leadership and team management skills to manage a team of professionals - comfort with conflict, giving and receiving feedback, and handling employee/Talent issues
Strong communication skills to collaborate with different stakeholders and manage sensitive cases, while remaining calm and poised under pressure
Organized and resourceful; able to juggle and multi-task, with an attention to detail and follow through even in ambiguous situations
In-depth understanding of customer service operations and processes; able to translate that to your team
Strategic thinking and problem-solving abilities to evaluate procedures and identify opportunities for improvement
Ability to cascade with context and lead your team through changes
Exceptional coaching skills, you have high EQ and know how to tailor your feedback & communication style to meet the needs of your coachee or mentee

About Anthropic
Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

Reporting into Partner Operations & Systems within Partner Experience, this role is the operations generalist behind the partner program — an ecosystem growing quickly, with volume growing faster and an operational layer still being designed.
The role has two anchors: intake — owning the front door for new process requests and building the intake process itself — and flexibility, serving as the generalist allocated to the most pressing operational issue at the time. You'll serve as the central hub for partner experience, working cross-functionally with Finance, RevOps, Sales, Enablement, Product, and Legal to ensure seamless execution of partnership strategy.

Own intake for new process requests: triage, scope, and prioritize needs across the partner organization and decide what gets built
Design new partner operations processes from zero to one: stand up the workflow, documentation, and requirements, and iterate with data
Build new AI automations with Claude: create and run Claude-powered automations and AI workflows across partner operations, taking them from prototype to production and improving them with use
Take on special operations projects: join small cross-functional teams on priority initiatives
Run the process and data side of registrations, referrals, incentives, applications, and onboarding, keeping the data decision-grade
Encode program policy in the systems: work with program owners so rules are enforced by systems, and own data hygiene for the partner record of truth
Enable partners and internal teams: build the guidance partners, Partner Managers, and Account Executives need for new initiatives
Collaborate across go-to-market: partner with Sales, Finance, Enablement, Marketing, and Revenue Operations to stay aligned with the business
Measure what matters: establish service levels and report on volume, cycle time, and the metrics that show what to fix next

4+ years in management consulting or investment banking, ideally paired with 1–3+ years in business operations, partner/channel operations, product operations, or a comparable role at an AI, enterprise software, or technology company
Strong project management ability with experience influencing cross-functional operational initiatives
Hands-on experience creating AI workflows with Claude or similar tools, and comfort running and improving them at operational volume
Experience with data analysis tools and reporting platforms (e.g., Hex, Looker, or similar)
Analytical mindset with the ability to derive actionable insights from complex datasets

Experience with deal registration systems, partner relationship management (PRM) platforms, and commission management tools
Previous experience at an AI/ML or other fast-scaling technology company
Experience with partner or channel program design, including tiering and program benefits
Hands-on Salesforce experience, including reporting, data imports, and workflow configuration
A track record of standing up operational processes, service levels, and reporting from scratch
Experience on a tiger team or task force assembled to solve high-priority problems quickly

How we're different
We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles.

We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills.
The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences.

Anthropic is expanding its reseller program in Japan and Korea.

As our Reseller Operations Manager for Japan and Korea, you'll own how resellers in both countries get onboarded, transact, get paid, and get supported, across both of our resale motions: hyperscaler resale, where partners resell Claude through the cloud marketplaces (AWS Bedrock today, Google Cloud Vertex AI and Microsoft Foundry to follow), and direct resale, where partners resell on Anthropic paper through our own quote-to-order and billing systems.

The global team builds the program; you make it work for Japanese and Korean partners and feed back what has to change.
This is an operator role, not a partner manager role. In the first months you'll be validating deal registrations and answering partner tickets yourself; by the end of the first year the volume should be running on documented process, service levels, and vendor or system coverage that you set up.

Own reseller onboarding for Japan and Korea end to end: application intake, screening coordination, agreement execution, marketplace authorization, entitlement setup, and activation, and keep the partner record in Salesforce decision-grade for both regions.
Run hyperscaler (3P) reseller operations: deal-registration intake and validation within SLA, marketplace authorizations and private-offer processing with the cloud alliance teams, and end-customer reporting on every reseller transaction so partner-sourced revenue can be attributed.
Run direct (1P) reseller operations: partner quotes and order forms, order booking and provisioning, and commit tracking and true-ups with Deal Desk, RevOps, and Accounting, and work with Finance and Tax on local invoicing, currency, and consumption-tax handling for each transaction route.
Run the regional side of reseller incentives: eligibility, validation of quarterly payouts, and partner disputes, in partnership with the global incentive operations team and Finance.
Stand up first-line operational support for resellers in Japanese and Korean during local business hours, inside the global partner support queue rather than alongside it, and localize the onboarding, deal-registration, and ordering content partners depend on.
Manage any outsourced or contracted operations capacity used in region (scope, quality, service levels) and coordinate with Enablement on the logistics of local-language certification and training.
Own reseller reporting for Japan and Korea: registration volume and cycle time, activation, attach, and attributed revenue by partner and by motion, and use it to tell the regional teams and the global program what to fix next.
Adopt the global Partner Operations playbooks where they fit, write the in-region variants where they don't, and represent Japan and Korea requirements in partner systems and automation work so manual volume doesn't grow with partner count.

Several years in channel, reseller, distribution, or partner operations at a technology company, ideally touching both a cloud-marketplace motion and a direct or contract-based resale motion.
Working proficiency in Japanese, Korean, and English. You'll run operational relationships with partners in both countries and work daily with a US-based team; proficiency doesn't need to be identical across all three, but you need to be able to work with partners in both regions.
Practical knowledge of how at least one major cloud marketplace's reseller program works (authorizations, private offers, deal registration), or deep experience in one motion and a track record of picking up the other quickly.
Hands-on experience with quote-to-order, order management, or partner billing, and the Finance, Deal Desk, and Legal coordination that comes with it.
A track record of taking a manual process and turning it into documented workflow, service levels, and reporting, including managing vendors or contractors who execute part of it.
Hands-on Salesforce experience (reporting, data maintenance), and comfort being the only operations person in the region while working with a team many time zones away.

Experience inside the Japanese or Korean enterprise reseller and systems-integrator ecosystem, including local invoicing, credit, and consumption-tax conventions.
Experience with partner incentive or rebate operations, or with a partner program during its launch phase.
Experience with PRM or deal-registration tooling, or building automations with Claude or similar tools to run operational workflows at volume.

s.h: How this role works with the team
s.t:
You'll report into Partner Experience and work day to day with two groups.

The global Partner Operations team in San Francisco owns the reseller program's systems, and playbooks; our reseller operations owner there is your direct counterpart, and you'll split work along a simple line: they own the global process, you own its execution and adaptation in Japan and Korea.

The Japan and Korea go-to-market teams own the partner relationships and the commercial conversations; you're the operational layer underneath them, and the person they come to when something about a partner's onboarding, order, or payout needs to move.

You'll also be the regional voice into Finance, Deal Desk, RevOps, and the cloud alliance teams on anything that has to work differently in these markets.

About Betterment
Betterment is a leading, technology-driven financial services company that offers investing, savings and retirement solutions for retail investors and investment advisors as well as financial wellness solutions, including a 401(k) for small and medium-sized businesses.

Our team is passionate about our mission, to empower people to build wealth with confidence and ease. We’re headquartered in NYC and offer hybrid NY-based positions (four days/ week in-office, with no required office days during the summer and winter holidays).

We're hiring an analyst and builder for our Revenue Operations team to be a force multiplier for our go-to-market organization. Sometimes that means tackling a question with no playbook yet. Sometimes it means running an established process and improving it as you go.
You'll take on ambiguous, high impact questions and turn them into clearly defined problems, design the right solution, and drive it through build, adoption, and continuous improvement.
The role has three modes. First, you'll drive the analytical core: forecasting, executive reporting, revenue planning, QBR-grade analyses over large datasets, quota and target analytics, and the models that support forecasting and planning. You'll present your own work directly to leadership and translate complex business questions into actionable insights.
Second, you'll build net-new systems: internal tools, data models, and reporting infrastructure that teammates then run and scale. That includes planning models, dashboards, and operational workflows that make the business more efficient over time.
Third, you'll make Revenue Operations more leveraged with AI, whether that's building AI-assisted tooling, designing account scoring and research logic in our go-to-market stack, or automating work that shouldn't be manual. You’ll constantly look for more opportunities to increase leverage across the organization.
The ideal candidate combines strong analytical horsepower with a systems mindset and genuine comfort with ambiguity. You ask why until you understand the business objective behind a request, you design solutions that scale beyond the first use case, and you already use AI to build and move faster than your job title suggests.

You’re naturally curious about how AI can improve the way work gets done, but you know technology is only valuable when it solves a real business problem. And you finish: to you, work is done when it's adopted, documented, and running without you, not when the analysis is shipped.
This role is based out of our NYC office.

Partner Operations Manager
The Global Merchant Excellence team
The Merchant excellence team is accountable for supporting restaurant and retail partners across all markets with key onboarding and lifecycle tasks, acting as their operational support team once they’re live on the platform.

Manages partner contacts across live and non‑live channels globally, with UKIE representing the largest share of demand.
Handles admin and technical tasks for SMB, Mid‑Market and National partners (e.g. account and menu creation, menu edits, tablet installation and troubleshooting, photography, compliance actions like DAC7, refund disputes, and inbound phone/chat support).
Acts as the sole point of contact for self‑serve partners after they “graduate” from early‑life onboarding, working closely with New Partner Experience and Account Management teams.
Operationally, most day‑to‑day volume is handled by third‑party vendors aligned by language and market. Our in-house teams own complex queries, escalations, and performance management across markets.

s.h: In this role you'll be involved in these key areas
s.t:
Managing channel, queue and team leader/ agent performance across our in-house teams in Manchester, UK and Milan, Italy.
Identifying trends in performance and conducting root cause analysis (e.g. Team Leader/agent productivity) to drive improved performance.
Present market performance updates and strategic implications to executive leadership.
Identify Operational efficiencies that can be gained through automation and process improvements.
What you’ll be doing
Monitoring and Tracking: Daily/weekly monitoring of key performance indicators (KPIs) for channels (e.g., chat, email, phone), service queues, team leaders, and individual agents across UKI and EU.
Root Cause Analysis (RCA): Conducting deep dives and methodical investigations to identify the fundamental reasons behind performance trends (e.g., analysing agent productivity, training gaps, system errors, or vendor operational issues).
Trend Identification: Analysing data to spot emerging or recurring patterns in team and channel performance, service demand, and partner feedback.
Developing and delivering clear, data-driven presentations on current market performance (likely related to partner satisfaction or service delivery) and the strategic impact of those results to executive leadership.
Change Management: Taking a structured approach to organisational development, process design and improvement and, system development in line with organisational goals and targets.
Insight Generation: Translating raw performance data and market trends into actionable insights and strategic recommendations for senior decision-makers.
Target Setting: Establishing challenging yet realistic performance targets and benchmarks for teams based on data analysis and industry best practices.
Opportunity Identification: Auditing existing workflows and processes to pinpoint areas where operational efficiencies can be achieved (e.g., manual data entry, handoffs between teams).
Automation Scoping: Proposing and evaluating potential automation solutions (e.g., RPA, self-service tools, AI-assisted routing) to reduce manual effort and improve service speed.
Implementation Support: Collaborating with technology and operations teams to pilot, test, and roll out approved process improvements and automation initiatives.
All these activities may extend to other LOB's as well as Merchant Operations.

Is comfortable leading updates and can speak up when working with more senior stakeholders and partners
Is knowledgeable of CRM systems (e.g. Zendesk / Salesforce) and has experience of creating reports across systems

Proven track record of managing and developing effective Team Leaders
Openness to travel quarterly to engage with your in house team

Fraud is constantly evolving. As our business grows, so do the ways bad actors seek to exploit our products, promotions, and operations.
As the Senior Strategy & Operations Manager for Emerging Fraud & Abuse, you'll lead the discovery, investigation, and mitigation of new and evolving abuse vectors across our platform. Your mission is to identify risks before they become systemic, working across Product, Engineering, Data Science, Operations, Legal, and Policy to design scalable solutions that protect our customers, partners, and business.
This isn't a role focused on running existing fraud programmes. It's about identifying what's next.
You'll combine deep analytical thinking with strategic problem solving to uncover emerging threats, quantify business impact, influence product strategy, and build new controls that keep us ahead of increasingly sophisticated fraudsters.
If you enjoy solving ambiguous problems, following the data, and building solutions where no playbook exists, we'd love to hear from you.

Identify Emerging Abuse
Proactively identify new fraud patterns, abuse trends, and vulnerabilities across our products, customer journeys, and operational processes.
Investigate anomalies, understand attacker behaviours, and translate observations into actionable mitigation strategies.
Continuously scan for evolving risks, whether driven by organised fraud, policy loopholes, technological change, or new product launches.
Build the Strategy
Define the roadmap for emerging fraud prevention across the business.
Prioritise risks based on customer impact, financial exposure, operational complexity, and strategic importance.
Develop business cases that influence investment in tooling, automation, machine learning, and product improvements.
Turn Insights into Action
Lead complex investigations to understand how abuse occurs and where existing controls can be strengthened.
Partner with Product, Engineering, and Data Science to design scalable prevention mechanisms rather than tactical fixes.
Establish metrics that measure both emerging risk and the effectiveness of mitigation strategies.
Drive Cross-Functional Execution
Act as the central point of coordination between Fraud, Product, Engineering, Trust & Safety, Customer Operations, Legal, Finance, and Data Science.
Influence roadmaps to ensure fraud prevention is embedded into product development from the earliest stages.
Support major product launches by identifying potential abuse scenarios and recommending preventative controls.
Build Organisational Capability
Develop frameworks for identifying, prioritising, and responding to emerging threats.
Improve how intelligence is shared across teams to ensure new attack patterns are detected and mitigated quickly.
Help foster a culture of proactive fraud prevention across the organisation.

We're looking for someone who thrives in ambiguity and enjoys solving complex, high-impact business problems.
You'll likely come from fraud, trust & safety, cybersecurity, payments, marketplaces, fintech, consulting, or another analytical environment where you've been responsible for identifying and solving new risks.

Experience investigating complex fraud, abuse, or operational risk problems

Discord has a highly engaged community of millions of daily active users who use the platform for many different reasons, but there’s one thing that nearly everyone does: play video games. Discord plays a uniquely important role in the future of gaming, and we are focused on making it easier and more fun for people to hang out before, during, and after playing games.

Strategy and Operations sits at the center of how we grow across multiple pillars at Discord. We're building the revenue engine for a business that is scaling fast. This team drives important strategic decisions, establishing operational rigor, and laying the foundation for core processes from the ground up, work that directly supports Discord's mission of building community and belonging at scale.

This is a build it yourself role: you'll be the dedicated Strategy & Operations hire supporting Discord's ad sales leaders, standing up pipeline and business health metrics, quota setting, bottoms up planning, and revenue forecasting from the ground up rather than stepping into an already established function.

You'll also lead strategic zero to one projects: building systems, processes, and tooling that enable our sales org to scale.

The scope is intentionally big, we're looking for a hands on, individual contributor builder, not a team builder or people manager, who can operate as a force multiplier, using AI tools, workflows, and automation to scale your output on the highest priority problems.

You'll partner directly and independently with sales leadership, present to executives, and influence cross-functional partners.
What You'll Be Doing
Own revenue forecasting and pipeline management, synthesizing your point of view on revenue growth, risks, and opportunities to leadership on a weekly and monthly cadence
Instrument and define pipeline and business health metrics on our Salesforce instance, building the analytics infrastructure this function needs from the ground up
Lead strategic assessments for new opportunities, including new market expansion, sales team scaling, and go to market optimization
Partner independently with sales leadership on territory design, account segmentation, and coverage models to maximize revenue potential and seller productivity
Lead the annual and quarterly goal setting process, ensuring quota targets are data driven, equitable, and support the ambitions of the business
Analyze sales cycle trends, win and loss patterns, and conversion rates to surface actionable insights that improve sales effectiveness
Drive continuous improvement of processes, tools, and workflows across the business to increase efficiency, reduce friction, and increase selling time
What you should have
9+ years of hands on, individual contributor experience in strategy and operations or sales operations at a fast growth company or in management consulting, this is a builder role, not a people management role
Genuine excitement about building a function from ambiguity, not just operating an established one, you've stood up a process or system from scratch before, not only refined an existing one
Executive presence and strong, independent stakeholder management, you're comfortable presenting to cross-functional partners and C-level executives, defending your recommendations, and influencing leaders to adopt new ways of thinking, without a manager in the room
A proven track record of developing analysis that yields actionable insights and executive level strategic recommendations from complex data sets, you can define unique metrics that matter, get into the details on data sources, and implement new approaches to capture new signals
Proven, hands on AI adoption in your day to day work, including agentic workflows, automated analysis, and AI assisted deliverables, you treat AI as core infrastructure and have specific examples of how it's scaled your output
A no ego, roll up your sleeves mentality and comfort thriving in ambiguous, fast paced environments
Experience with CRM systems, such as Salesforce, and proficiency in analytics tools

Experience working directly with sales leaders and or in media and advertising
A unicorn background: sales ops, rev ops, or sales finance experience at a well run, well resourced company, followed by a move to a smaller, scrappier environment
Management consulting background
Startup experience

EBANX is one of the most successful fintechs to emerge from Latin America — and today, we are building a truly global payments company. Our mission has remained constant from day one: to unlock access and enable companies and consumers to participate in the digital economy, no matter where they are.
What started as a bold vision has grown into a platform that connects some of the world’s largest digital businesses with customers across 21 of the fastest-growing markets. We operate where complexity exists — turning local challenges into global opportunities and building the infrastructure that allows payments to move further, faster, and smarter.
We are a team of builders and problem-solvers. We think globally, act with curiosity, and believe diversity of thought is a competitive advantage.
As EBANX enters its next phase of hyper growth, we are looking for people who want to shape the future of payments, expand what’s possible, and help connect businesses and consumers across borders.
Let’s build what’s next — together.

Lead the identification, analysis, and prioritization of strategic initiatives to significantly improve payment authorization rates and overall payment performance.

Own end-to-end payment optimization projects, from opportunity assessment and prioritization through implementation and post-launch performance analysis.
Translate complex payment data into clear insights and strategic recommendations for senior leadership and key stakeholders.
Partner closely with Product, Engineering, Data Science, and Operations teams to incorporate payment performance insights into product development and operational decisions.
Evaluate the performance of acquirers, processors, payment methods, and other key partners, identifying opportunities for improvement and supporting commercial and technical discussions.

Strong experience in payment performance, payment operations, business analytics, data analytics, or a related field.
Advanced analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to transform large and complex datasets into actionable business insights.
Solid knowledge of payment ecosystems, including authorization flows, declines, acquirers, processors, issuers, card networks, and alternative payment methods.
Advanced proficiency in SQL and experience using data visualization and business intelligence tools.
Experience developing analytical models, monitoring frameworks, forecasts, or experiments focused on performance optimization.
Proven ability to lead complex, cross-functional initiatives from conceptualization to implementation and impact measurement.
Strong stakeholder management and communication skills, including the ability to present technical findings and strategic recommendations to senior audiences.
Ability to influence decisions, manage competing priorities, and operate effectively in a fast-paced, global environment.
Advanced English communication skills.

Experience working in fintech, e-commerce, acquiring, payment processing, banking, or card networks.
Knowledge of statistical modeling, experimentation, machine learning, or predictive analytics applied to payment performance.
Proficiency in Python or another programming language used for data analysis.
Experience working with payment performance across multiple countries, regions, currencies, or alternative payment methods.
Previous experience mentoring analysts or providing technical leadership to analytics teams.
Knowledge of fraud prevention, risk management, routing strategies, tokenization, or payment orchestration.
Experience managing or negotiating with payment partners and external providers.

About Gusto
At Gusto, we're on a mission to grow the small business economy. We handle the hard stuff — payroll, health insurance, 401(k)s, and HR — so owners can focus on their craft and their customers. With teams in Denver, San Francisco, and New York, we support more than 500,000 small businesses nationwide and are building a workplace that reflects the people we serve.
All full-time employees receive competitive base pay, benefits, and equity (RSUs) — because everyone who helps build Gusto should share in its success. Offer amounts are determined by role, level, and location. Learn more about our Total Rewards philosophy .
AI is a fundamental part of how work gets done at Gusto. We expect all team members to actively engage with AI tools relevant to their role and grow their fluency as the technology evolves. AI experience requirements vary by role and will be assessed during the interview process.

Payments at Gusto aren't just infrastructure — they're the reason people get paid on time, every time. Payment Operations sits within Gusto's Money team, a cross-functional group spanning Engineering, Product, and Operations that powers money movement across Gusto's growing product surface: core payroll, contractor payments, international money movement, and new business offerings like PEO.
As a Payment Operations Analyst, you'll own specific end-to-end payment workflows, resolve exceptions that require real judgment, and help make our systems more reliable and efficient over time. Gusto's payment surface area is expanding — and this team is at the center of that growth.
This is a role for someone who can shift from investigating a single misfired transaction to coordinating a response on a payment outage affecting thousands — and bring the same rigor to both. You think in systems. You hold partners accountable. You lead with curiosity and embrace AI as a core part of how you work.
You'll collaborate closely with Engineering, Product, Accounting, Risk, and CX — and you'll develop strong day-to-day relationships with Gusto's bank and payment partners. When something breaks or slows down, you're the one who drives it to resolution.

Support the payment lifecycle end-to-end
Own the operational layer of specific payment workflows — ACH processing, exception handling, refunds, collection re-debits, reconciliation. When something is off, you investigate, escalate where needed, and see it through to resolution. And when you see a pattern, you push to fix the root cause.
Build alongside Product and Engineering
Payment Operations doesn't just react — we shape how the systems work. You'll contribute to product specs, surface operational pain points, help define requirements, and participate in launches. You're a partner in building, not just a consumer of what gets shipped.
Close the loop on customer pain
Customer and CX feedback is signal. You actively mine it to identify friction in payment flows, prioritize what matters, and bring those insights into the operational and product conversations where decisions get made.
Think in systems
Connect the dots across rails, partners, reconciliation, compliance, and customer experience. When an issue surfaces, you understand how it ripples — and you bring that perspective to cross-functional conversations.
Hold partners to a high standard
Work directly with Gusto's bank and payment partners — domestic and international — to triage issues, resolve escalations, and maintain strong working relationships. You know how to be firm and collaborative at the same time, and you don't let things sit.
Lead with AI
You use AI as a genuine work partner — to move faster on analysis, draft communications, synthesize data, and automate the repetitive. You're always looking for the smarter way to get to the answer.

3+ years of experience in payment operations, banking operations, treasury operations, or a related role at a fintech or financial institution
Working knowledge of domestic payment rails (ACH/Nacha, wires, RTP) and/or international money movement (cross-border transfers, FX, global disbursement networks); experience across both is a strong plus
Strong analytical instincts — you look for the pattern behind the problem and can query or structure data to find it (SQL a plus but not required)
Experience working with bank portals, payment processors, or reconciliation tools
Ability to communicate clearly with both operational and technical counterparts; you can write a crisp Slack to an engineer and a professional escalation to a bank partner
Comfortable working in ambiguity and taking ownership without waiting for perfect information
Eager to build AI into how you work — whether you're already using it daily or just getting started, you see it as a genuine productivity lever and are committed to developing that fluency
Knowledge of relevant compliance frameworks (Nacha operating rules, unclaimed property, money transmission) is a strong plus

Financial Services Compliance and Payroll Compliance own these programs; you're the operational partner who keeps documentation, controls, and evidence current and coordinates with them and GRC when new requirements land.
Drive incident response for payment operations
When something breaks at scale, whether it's a failed batch, a reconciliation break, or a payment partner outage, you're in the investigation yourself, not just directing it. You keep stakeholders informed and drive the retro that prevents it from happening again.
Partner with Product and Engineering
Bring the team's operational insight into product and engineering conversations. Flag risk early, weigh in on payment-related specs, and make sure operational needs are represented, without owning the product roadmap yourself.
Lead with AI
Model and encourage the use of AI across the team, whether that's faster investigation, cleaner documentation, or automating repetitive work.

7+ years of hands-on experience in payment operations, banking operations, or treasury operations, including direct ownership of escalations, partner issues, or ticket queues, and 2+ years directly managing a team
Deep working knowledge of domestic payment rails (ACH/Nacha, wires, RTP) and experience with international money movement is a strong plus
Experience managing the operational side of a bank or payment partner relationship, including escalations, issue triage, and partner reviews
Track record of operating within a compliance program (Nacha Risk Self-Assessment, SOC 1, unclaimed property, or similar), including audits and controls work
Strong people leadership: you've hired, coached, and managed performance for a team of analysts or similar operational ICs
Comfortable operating with real ambiguity and driving cross-functional work without needing a fully defined process
AI-fluent: you use it as a genuine lever for yourself and expect your team to as well
Nacha AAP or AFPP certification is a strong plus

This is your chance to shape the foundation of a fast-growing, high-impact part of Gusto's business as a Senior Sales Operations Analyst supporting our Expansion Sales organization.

You'll build the insights and AI-powered solutions that make a large, multi-team sales organization more productive — spanning our Platform Sales, Expansion AM, and New Expansion Advisor teams.

You'll sit at the intersection of data, process, and execution; you'll turn real sales challenges into the tools, reports, automations, and workflows that move the numbers.
You'll help grow revenue from Gusto's existing customer base through upsells and cross-sells. If you thrive where analytics, problem-solving, and supporting others meet, this role offers ownership, visibility, and the chance to influence how Gusto expands its relationship with the small businesses it already serves.

The Expansion Sales Operations team partners closely with sales leadership to support three dynamic, fast-moving sales teams that contribute meaningfully to Gusto's growth. We think of ourselves as builders, problem solvers, and strategic partners; we turn uncertainty into clarity and fragmented processes into scalable, repeatable systems.
Our work spans pacing and pipeline forecasting, quotas, trigger and backlog management, process design, data integrity, account and territory administration, rules of engagement, and increasingly, AI-driven optimization. We value curiosity, open communication, and a commitment to helping our reps operate efficiently and confidently across a multi-product, multi-team motion.

Analytics, Reporting & Forecasting
Build, automate, and maintain reports and dashboards that track pacing, funnel metrics, trigger and backlog health, SLAs, and rep productivity; keep definitions consistent and documentation clear.
Own the weekly forecast, CFQ closed-won ARR pacing, and probability-weighted pipeline forecast, feeding the Weekly Business Review (WBR) and Weekly Forecast Review (WFR) cadence for sales and executive leadership.
Partner with Finance and Analytics to produce operational reporting and revenue insights across dials, connects, lead passes, self-generated opportunities, and book coverage.
Own metric definitions and data accuracy so leaders trust the numbers they act on.
Drive AI Strategy for Sales
Identify and prototype AI and automation tools, such as process automation, analytics copilots, and call coaching, that remove manual friction from the sales process.
Partner with Sales, BizTech, Product, and Enablement to embed AI into daily sales workflows, improving both efficiency and effectiveness.
Source and lead net-new AI and automation projects, connecting data insights to process improvements that lift rep productivity.
Process Design & Continuous Improvement
Examine workflows and rep performance to identify bottlenecks; recommend and implement process and automation changes that improve conversion, efficiency, and the rep experience.
Evaluate Rules of Engagement (ROE) requests and comp exception asks, applying clear rules and precedent to produce fair, consistent, and binding rulings.
Partner with Sales Enablement to document processes, build playbooks, and drive adoption of new tools and workflows.
Operational Support & Problem-Solving
Provide day-to-day support to Expansion Sales leadership and reps: ad hoc data requests, process issues, and one-off investigations.
Own account and territory administration as the business evolves: assignment and coverage upkeep, book reassignments for leave and departures, large-scale account rerouting, and segment reclassification, supported by lead-routing and round-robin (ChiliPiper) automation.
Support onboarding and offboarding for new hires and departing reps, including roster updates, router mapping, and leave-of-absence (LOA) processing.
Troubleshoot reporting issues, broken workflows, missing CRM data, and gaps in pipeline visibility with fast, accurate fixes — including closed-won opportunities that didn't sync and ARR discrepancies.
Cross-Functional Partnership & Communication
Work closely with Sales Leadership, RevOps, Finance, BizTech, and Product to keep everyone aligned and remove obstacles to progress.
Translate sales challenges into clear business requirements; partner cross-functionally to design solutions and durable improvements.
Keep stakeholders aligned with clear, regular updates to managers and senior leadership on timelines, risks, and outcomes.
Act as a trusted advisor, bringing structure, insight, and clarity to complex or ambiguous problems.

5+ years in Sales Ops, RevOps, or a similar analytical GTM role; ideally in a fast-paced SaaS or fintech environment.
Strong Salesforce proficiency; you can spot data issues, audit pipeline problems, manage account ownership and routing, and build reports and dashboards that reps and leaders actually use.
Analytical depth across Salesforce reports and dashboards, SQL, Tableau or Looker, and Excel/Google Sheets.
Hands-on experience with forecasting, pipeline management, and territory or quota planning on a recurring cadence; for example, a weekly forecast feeding monthly reviews and QBRs.
Comfort evaluating AI and automation tools and prototyping simple workflows to improve productivity.

Estamos contratando Business Operations Analyst para se juntar ao nosso time de Business Transformation em São Paulo!
Nossa missão é aprimorar a rotina operacional de nossas pessoas clientes, tornando nossos processos escaláveis e padronizados, buscando ser a área de referência dentro do Wellhub e garantindo a qualidade na execução, sempre em parceria com outros times internos.

Colaborar com diversos times da organização, tanto técnicos quanto não técnicos, para garantir entregas bem-sucedidas.
Desenvolver soluções para aumentar a eficiência dos times operacionais parceiros, otimizando seu tempo e implementando controles para mitigar possíveis erros.
Gerenciar expectativas e contornar objeções de forma eficaz.

Conhecimento em Excel.
Capacidade analítica para interpretar dados, extrair insights e elaborar apresentações corporativas.
Perfil proativo, com foco na resolução de problemas e na satisfação da pessoa cliente.
Fortes habilidades de comunicação verbal e escrita, com ótimo relacionamento interpessoal e colaborativo.
Inglês avançado (obrigatório).

HelloFresh is looking for a Creative Operations Manager to join our Global Creative Operations team in New York. This role will serve as the operational lead for our fast-growing brands, partnering closely with Marketing, Creative, Production, and cross-functional stakeholders to deliver high-impact campaigns, product launches, and always-on marketing initiatives.
Reporting to the Creative Operations Lead, North America , this role serves as the Creative Operations partner for the HelloFresh portfolio of brands, ensuring successful execution of the brand's strategic marketing initiatives while collaborating with the broader North American Creative Operations organization.

The ideal candidate is an exceptional operator who thrives in a fast-paced environment, brings structure to complex initiatives, and continuously identifies opportunities to improve processes, increase efficiency, and enable creative teams to do their best work.
You will...
Own Creative Operations
Lead end-to-end operational management across integrated marketing initiatives, overseeing project planning, execution, and delivery from intake through final asset release across digital, print, packaging, video, photography, CRM, and lifecycle marketing.
Lead Strategic Marketing Initiatives
Manage operational delivery for major business priorities including Peak campaigns, product launches, refreshed meal photography, strategic partnerships, packaging initiatives, brand campaigns, and cross-channel marketing programs, ensuring milestones are met and deliverables are executed on time.
Cross-Functional Partnership
Serve as the primary Creative Operations partner for Brand Marketing, Creative, Production, Lifecycle Marketing, Product Marketing, Packaging, and external agency partners, ensuring alignment on priorities, timelines, deliverables, and business objectives.
Resource & Capacity Management
Partner with the Creative Resource Manager and Creative Operations Lead to forecast upcoming work, balance team capacity, identify resourcing risks, and recommend freelance or agency support as business needs evolve.
Drive Operational Excellence
Oversee the end-to-end creative lifecycle across multiple concurrent initiatives while continuously improving workflows, intake processes, project governance, and ways of working to increase speed-to-market and operational efficiency.
Project & Production Leadership
Develop and manage complex integrated project plans, coordinating cross-functional teams through creative development, production, reviews, approvals, and final asset delivery while proactively identifying risks and removing blockers.
Workflow & Systems Optimization
Champion best practices across project management systems and operational tools, driving adoption of standardized processes while identifying opportunities for automation and scalable operational improvements.
Data-Driven Reporting
Build and maintain reporting that provides visibility into project health, team capacity, delivery performance, and operational metrics, enabling informed decision-making across Creative Operations and Marketing leadership.
Continuous Improvement
Lead retrospectives following major campaigns, productions, and launches, documenting learnings and implementing scalable process improvements that strengthen creative operations across the organization.
You have...
5+ years of experience in Creative Operations, Creative Project Management, or integrated marketing operations, including direct experience managing creative workflows within an in-house creative team, agency, or studio environment
Bachelor's degree required
Demonstrated experience leading complex, cross-functional marketing initiatives from planning through execution
Strong understanding of integrated creative workflows across digital, print, packaging, photography and video production
Experience partnering with Marketing, Creative, Production, and cross-functional stakeholders
Strong project planning, organizational, prioritization, and risk management skills
Experience working within project management platforms such as Airtable, Jira, Asana, Monday.com, Workfront, or similar tools
Experience using reporting and resource planning tools to support operational decision-making
Excellent communication, stakeholder management, and relationship-building skills
Passion for process improvement, operational excellence, and building scalable ways of working
You'll get...
Competitive salary, 401k with company match that vests immediately upon participation
Generous PTO, including sabbatical, and parental leave of up to 16 weeks
Comprehensive health and wellness benefits with options at $0 monthly, effective first day of employment
Tuition reimbursement for continuing education (upon 2 years of service)
Up to 85% discount on subscriptions to HelloFresh meal plans (HelloFresh, Green Chef, Everyplate, and Factor_)
Access to Employee Resource Groups that are open to all employees, including those pertaining to BIPOC, women, veterans, parents, and LGBTQ+
Inclusive, collaborative, and dynamic work environment within a fast-paced, mission-driven company that is disrupting the traditional food supply chain

s.t:
Based in Auckland and reporting to the ANZ CEO, the General Manager for New Zealand leads the overall performance, growth and strategic direction of HelloFresh New Zealand; one of the HelloFresh’s most established and innovative markets.

Owning the New Zealand P&L end-to-end, you set the strategy to maximize sustainable growth and profitability, sharpen the local proposition, and represent HelloFresh with government, regulators, partners and the wider community.

You deliver through influence, aligning matrixed teams across growth, product, marketing, finance, customer care and operations behind a shared plan.
Above all, you will change the way Kiwis eat, forever!

Own the P&L: Take full accountability for HelloFresh New Zealand’s commercial and financial performance, leading annual planning, forecasting and business reviews with ANZ and Global leadership.
Set the strategy: Define and execute the roadmap that returns the market to sustainable growth and profitability across customer acquisition, retention, pricing and margin.
Sharpen the proposition: Partner with Global teams to pilot new products and propositions, and strengthen the local relevance of HelloFresh for Kiwi customers.
Lead through influence: Align and energise matrixed teams across growth, product, marketing, finance, customer care and operations to reach shared business objectives without direct line authority.
Represent the business: Act as the senior spokesperson for HelloFresh New Zealand with government, regulators, industry bodies and strategic partners.
Shape Group strategy: Feed insight, innovation and learnings from New Zealand back into regional and Global decision-making.

P&L leadership: A track record of owning a P&L or a major commercial function, ideally blending top-tier consulting, high-growth startup or comparable fast-paced experience.
Commercial and product instinct: Strong grounding in D2C marketing and product development, with the judgement to turn strategy into measurable growth.
Influence without authority: The ability to set clear direction and bring senior, matrixed stakeholders along through collaboration rather than formal reporting lines.
Data-driven mindset: A highly analytical approach, comfortable using data to prioritise and to hold the business to its plan.
Local market understanding: Familiarity with the New Zealand market and consumer, or a real ability to build local relevance and credibility quickly.
Drive and food enthusiasm: Entrepreneurial energy, resilience and a genuine enthusiasm for good food and the HelloFresh mission.

Compensation with upside: A highly attractive package with significant equity upside for a senior leader in a leading global food-technology company.
Own a market: The rare chance to lead an entire market and shape its direction end to end.
Hybrid working: Three days in the Auckland office and two days working from home each week.
Work from anywhere: Up to three weeks working from a location of your choice in any 12-month period.
Wellbeing support: Free Headspace access (extendable to five friends or family) and a confidential Employee Assistance Program.
Learning and growth: HelloFresh Academy sessions, a function-led L&D budget and a structured mentoring program.
Time to recharge: Additional HF Days that grow with tenure, plus sabbatical leave for longer-serving team members.
HelloFresh discount: 70% off your HelloFresh boxes, plus friends-and-family discounts.

Ready to level up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You're in the right place. Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.
What’s the opportunity?
As a Senior Sales Operations Manager, you will be a strategic and operational partner to Fin’s Sales organization, helping build the systems, processes, reporting, and operating rhythms that enable our go-to-market teams to scale effectively.
You’ll work at the intersection of Sales, Finance, Business Systems, Data Engineering, Marketing, and GTM leadership. You’ll own critical sales operations programs across forecasting, pipeline management, territory and quota planning, compensation, performance reporting, and process optimization.
This is a high-impact role for a systems thinker and commercially minded operator who can move comfortably between detailed analysis, cross-functional program management, and executive-level recommendations. You’ll have the opportunity to improve how Fin’s sales organization operates while helping scale the GTM engine behind one of the fastest-growing AI products in the market.
What will I be doing?
Own and optimize core sales operations processes, systems, and operating cadences across the sales organization.
Partner with Sales leadership and Finance to build and maintain forecasting processes, pipeline reporting, quota models, attainment tracking, and performance insights.
Develop clear, trusted reporting and dashboards that give leaders visibility into funnel health, productivity, conversion, win rates, capacity, and revenue performance.
Lead territory planning, segmentation, coverage, and capacity analysis to support efficient allocation of sales resources.
Partner with Finance and Sales leadership on compensation planning, plan administration, performance measurement, and reporting.
Translate business requirements into scalable solutions across CRM, BI, sales planning, compensation, and other GTM systems.
Partner with Business Systems and Data Engineering to improve data quality, data models, integrations, automation, and reporting infrastructure.
Identify and eliminate operational bottlenecks across the sales cycle, including lead routing, opportunity management, approvals, contracting, handoffs, and post-sale transitions.
Establish and maintain consistent definitions, governance, documentation, and processes for key sales metrics and data.
Lead complex cross-functional projects from discovery through implementation, including requirements gathering, stakeholder alignment, testing, rollout, and change management.
Build executive-ready analyses and recommendations that help leadership make decisions about growth, investment, productivity, and organizational design.
Use AI tools and automation thoughtfully to reduce manual work, improve data access, and increase the speed and quality of sales execution.
Create scalable operating processes that support growth without requiring linear increases in headcount.
Act as a trusted advisor to sales leadership on performance trends, operational risks, process improvements, and strategic priorities.
Support quarterly and annual planning activities, including business reviews, headcount planning, goal-setting, and operating plan development.
What skills do I need?
5+ years of experience in Sales Operations, Revenue Operations, GTM Strategy, Sales Strategy & Operations, Business Operations, or a related field, preferably in a high-growth technology or SaaS company.
Strong understanding of sales processes, forecasting, pipeline management, quota and territory planning, compensation, and sales performance metrics.
Experience owning or significantly improving CRM, BI, planning, compensation, or revenue technology systems.
Strong analytical skills, with the ability to translate complex data into clear insights and practical recommendations.
Advanced Excel or Google Sheets skills and experience with BI or reporting tools such as Tableau, Looker, Power BI, or similar.
Familiarity with Salesforce or comparable CRM platforms; experience partnering with Business Systems or Data Engineering teams is highly valuable.
Experience designing scalable processes, data governance frameworks, reporting systems, and operational workflows.
Ability to manage complex, cross-functional programs with multiple stakeholders and competing priorities.
Strong commercial judgment and the ability to connect operational improvements to revenue outcomes.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to present recommendations to senior leaders.
Comfortable working hands-on in the details while maintaining a strategic view of the broader business.
AI fluency and curiosity about applying AI, automation, and emerging tools to improve sales productivity and operational efficiency.
High ownership, sound judgment, intellectual curiosity, and a bias toward action.
Comfortable and energized operating in a fast-moving, ambiguous environment where priorities evolve quickly.

The Opportunity
Reporting to the Operations Manager, AV Depot, the Associate Operations Manager is the second leadership layer at the Nashville AV depot. This role exists because one Operations Manager cannot provide the people leadership, floor coverage, and operational bandwidth a 24/7 depot of this scale requires.
The Associate Operations Manager carries ownership across two critical business workstreams: workforce scheduling support and process standards compliance. Fleet Operations Leads report to the Operations Manager — but during mid shifts, the Associate Operations Manager is the operational authority on the floor, directing their work, setting the quality standard, and serving as their most experienced resource and mentor.
This is a management role with a floor orientation. The Associate Operations Manager is present, coaching, directing, and executing alongside the team — while simultaneously carrying business responsibilities that directly impact depot readiness and partner compliance. This role is the bridge between the Fleet Operations Lead layer and the Operations Manager.

Scheduling & Workforce Planning Support
Owns the depot schedule — building, maintaining, and adjusting shift coverage across all teams to ensure the depot is consistently staffed and operationally ready.
Monitors attendance, manages real-time coverage gaps, and proactively addresses workforce trends before they become operational problems.
Partners with the Operations Manager on workforce planning, surfacing scheduling risks and recommendations with enough lead time to act.
Training Program Execution & Certification Compliance
Owns the planning and coordination of training program execution across all shift teams — ensuring Fleet Operations Associates and Fleet Operations Leads are scheduled, prepared, and on track to complete required partner certifications, safety refreshers, and qualification renewals.
Maintains certification and qualification records for the team, flagging upcoming renewals and escalating compliance risks to the Operations Manager before they become audit findings.
Partners with the Program Lead Trainer to ensure qualified trainers are in place, training resources are available, and delivery stays consistent across shift teams.
Floor Execution & Quality Standards
Lead the day-to-day execution of critical operational systems and processes for our 24/7 AV fleet management operations, including depot layout adherence, vehicle flow (charging, cleaning, maintenance, staging, diagnostics), parts management, and data handling.
Serves as the operational authority during mid shifts — directing Fleet Operations Leads and Fleet Operations Associates on task execution, resolving workflow conflicts, and holding the floor accountable to depot performance targets.
Owns quality on shift: vehicle readiness, safety inspections, and quality standards — inspecting, enforcing, and setting the standard by working alongside the team.
Maintains accurate shift documentation and manages shift handoffs with discipline, ensuring the incoming Fleet Operations Lead has full situational awareness and no items fall through the gap.
Fleet Operations Lead Mentorship & Operational Direction
Directs Fleet Operations Leads operationally on shift — task priorities, execution decisions, real-time escalations.
Serves as the most experienced senior leader in the building in absence of the Operations Manager, providing in-the-moment coaching and surfacing structured performance observations to the Operations Manager.

What We Do
RELEX runs the planning decisions behind 600+ retailers and manufacturers worldwide, deciding, at real scale, what gets forecast, stocked, priced, promoted, and produced across the entire value chain.

Few problems combine this much data, this much complexity, and this much real-world weight: get it right and a shelf stays stocked, a factory line doesn’t stall, food doesn’t spoil in a warehouse before it’s sold. Get it wrong, and it shows up in actual losses, for some of the largest retail and manufacturing brands in the world.
We’ve grown for 76 consecutive quarters straight, and it’s still accelerating. The first half of 2026 was the strongest in the company’s history. We’re a team of 2,000+ people, headquartered in Helsinki, with offices across Europe, North America, and Asia-Pacific.
In response to our fast growth and market expansion, we are looking for ...
What we need you to do and be
Calculate monthly sales commissions, process manual adjustments, and maintain accurate crediting records across the sales organization.
Conduct crediting reviews and periodic audits, catching and resolving discrepancies before they reach the field.
Coordinate with Payroll to ensure commission payments are processed accurately and on schedule each cycle.
Investigate and resolve compensation disputes raised by sellers and managers, escalating complex cases where needed.
Administer and maintain our sales compensation platform, keeping calculations, adjustments, and records current and reliable. This includes improving the platform's UI and the seller experience so sellers see only what's relevant to their own commissions, driving transparency and adoption across the field.
Lead the rollout of a contracts platform into the deal-closing motion, including configuration and automation that connects signed contracts to the compensation and booking process.
Design and formalize a bookings review and reconciliation process, partnering with Finance to validate the bookable figures that drive seller payouts.
Serve as a first line of support for sellers, fielding and resolving questions on payments, timing, and crediting.
Document new processes as they take shape, building a clear reference for the team as compensation administration scales with the business.

You will translate global product and publishing plans into clear local operating plans, ensure partners are prepared for launches and programs, and improve Riot’s visibility into retail performance, product availability, and operational risks.
As this is a new capability for Riot, you will also help define scalable processes and ways of working for retail operations in Korea. You will report to Director, Publishing.

Develop and execute Riftbound’s retail operations plan for Korea.
Lead retail readiness for product launches, promotional releases, and major campaign moments.
Coordinate product information, partner communications, retail materials, training, timelines, and reporting.
Serve as Riot’s primary operational partner for distributors and priority retailers.
Establish clear operating rhythms, expectations, and issue-resolution processes with external partners.
Partner with Publishing, Community, and Organized Play to deliver retail activations, launch events, demos, and promotional programs.
Support the growth of Korea’s TCG stores, PC Bangs, and organized-play network. Monitor product availability, retail coverage, partner execution, and demand signals.
Identify operational risks and coordinate mitigation plans across Riot and external partners. Build repeatable processes, reporting, and documentation that improve future launches and retail programs.

6+ years of experience in retail operations, commercial operations, channel management, trade marketing, distribution, or a related field.
Experience working with physical consumer products through retailers, distributors, or specialty-store channels.
Experience leading product launches or complex operational programs with internal and external partners.
Strong understanding of Korean retail practices and market dynamics.
Experience managing distributors, retailers, agencies, vendors, or other business partners.
Strong project management, analytical, and problem-solving skills.
Ability to independently drive work from planning through execution.
Fluency in Korean and English, both written and spoken.

Experience in trading card games, tabletop games, collectibles, toys, entertainment merchandise, or hobby products.
Familiarity with Korea’s hobby-store, specialty-retail, PC Bangs or organized-play ecosystem.
Experience with product availability, allocation, sell-through reporting, or promotional fulfillment.
Experience building a new operational function or partner model.

Building reliable retail operating processes for Riftbound in Korea.
Ensuring partners are prepared for launches and programs.
Establishing strong relationships with distributors and retailers.
Improving visibility into product availability and retail performance.
Resolving operational issues quickly and reducing recurring friction.
Creating scalable systems that support Riftbound’s long-term growth.

We are looking for a strategic and analytical Revenue Operations Manager to join the Brands team at Roblox. In this role, you will build and own the RevOps function for our Brands advertising business, establishing the rhythm of business, forecasting infrastructure, and GTM operational backbone that enables our Sales and Ad Ops teams to scale.

You will be both a systems thinker and a hands-on executor, translating data into executive-ready insights while driving alignment across Sales, Ad Ops, Product, and Finance.

Revenue Planning & Forecasting
Own pipeline and revenue forecasting for the Brands business, maintaining views of funnel health, pacing, and yield across ad products and verticals.
Build and manage operational dashboards that surface where deals are progressing, stalling, or at risk.
Define and maintain metric standards (e.g., pipeline stages, pacing benchmarks, utilization rates) to ensure consistent reporting across the team.
Rhythm of Business (RoB)
Design and run the Brands weekly business review (WBR), including pre-reads, pipeline and pacing commentary, and follow-up tracking.
Produce executive-ready narratives that translate operational data into clear strategic recommendations.
Own follow-up tracking and accountability across XFN stakeholders.
GTM & Cross-Functional Execution
Translate GTM priorities into clear, actionable in-market plans for the Brands Sales and Ad Ops teams.
Act as the point of contact between Sales, Ad Ops, Product, and Finance to resolve cross-functional misalignment.
Support quarterly planning processes including territory planning, goaling, and book-building.
Reporting Infrastructure & Automation
Partner with Data and Engineering to automate manual reporting workflows, moving the team toward real-time dashboards.
Identify and remove high-friction reporting tasks currently consuming FTE bandwidth.
Maintain CRM data quality standards to ensure planning and forecasting inputs are accurate and consistent.
Operational Rigor & Process Design
Document and systematize repeatable operational processes — from media plan intake to campaign pacing to client reporting.
Identify bottlenecks across the Brands ops workflow and drive resolution in partnership with Product and Engineering.
Identify opportunities to leverage tooling to reduce manual work and speed up decision-making.

8+ years of experience in revenue operations, programmatic, sales operations, or a related function within digital advertising or media.
Strong analytical skills; comfortable building and interpreting pipeline models, pacing dashboards, and funnel analyses. SQL or equivalent data querying experience a plus.
Experience designing and running a rhythm of business (WBR, QBR, or equivalent) for a sales or revenue-generating team.
Proven ability to translate complex data into clear executive narratives and drive decisions across senior stakeholders.
Strong cross-functional collaboration skills; able to drive alignment across Sales, Product, Finance, and Operations.
Highly organized with a track record of building repeatable, scalable processes.

Rocket Lab is the end-to-end space company building rockets, spacecraft, and critical subsystems that keep the world connected, protected, expand humanity’s reach to the Moon, Mars, and beyond. We move fast, build real hardware for meaningful missions, and make the impossible routine. Come shape the future with us.

At Rocket Lab, we’re not just launching rockets — we're building the future of space. Our Space Systems team builds everything from complete spacecraft, precision payloads to the components and subsystems that allow them to thrive in space, like solar panels, flight software, star trackers, optical systems, separation systems, radios, and more.
Our Space Systems team has enabled more than 1,700 missions, ranging from interplanetary exploration, in-space manufacturing to national security and defense initiatives. The team has built spacecraft, payloads, and components for missions to the Moon and Mars, working with partners including NASA, the Space Development Agency, and the U.S.

Space Force. Whether it’s a single high-performance spacecraft, constellation, or the vertically integrated components that help them get to space — our world class Space Systems team is empowering some of the boldest and most ambitious space missions.

Generate creative and scalable solutions to high impact problems.

Implement reporting and autonomy across all business needs.
